plain: Not granted to anyone; powers not handed over to the government

webster.text: Not delegated; not deputed; not granted; as undelegated authority; undelegated powers.

example.quote: and that therefore this commonwealth is determined, as it doubts not its co-States are, to submit to undelegated, and consequently unlimited powers in no man, or body of men on earth:
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Draft of the Kentucky Resolutions, Oct. 1798
